CustomField.description: Total INR component after discounts and additional costs and including tax
CustomField.formula: CASE( Booking_Status__c, "Approved", ( Tour_Plan__r.Cost_INR__c + INR_Component__c - Standard_Discount__c - Special_Discount__c - INR_Component_Reduction__c ), "Rejected", ( Tour_Plan__r.Cost_INR__c + INR_Component__c - Standard_Discount__c - Special_Discount__c), "Send for approval", ( Tour_Plan__r.Cost_INR__c + INR_Component__c - Standard_Discount__c - Special_Discount__c), 0)
CustomField.label: Total INR
